newsSince: Babcock & Wilcox has one of the most direct new scaling links: Q1 2026 revenue rose 44% to $214.4M, bookings reached $2.5B, backlog reached $2.7B, and the Base Electron project ties 1.2 GW of dedicated gas generation to Applied Digital AI data centers. The bear case is a $79.6M GAAP loss driven by warrant revaluation and fresh equity dilution.

verdicts.rankRationale: The 1.2GW AI-data-center power project and $2.7B backlog are directly on scaling/power. The stock's drawdown reflects dilution and warrant accounting, but the thesis relevance improved enough to move it up from a low rank.
verdicts.bull: 1.2GW Base Electron NTP plus prior 1GW Applied Digital give multi-year AI-power backlog visibility into 2028.
verdicts.neutral: Order book is known; execution and a pending fraud suit cap incremental upside this window.
verdicts.bear: Securities class action alleging concealed contract risks; design-build execution and gas-turbine supply chain risk.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: AI data-center power backlog conversion to revenue
